extraction.Name: Charles Cuny, Junior
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent to his 160 acre allotment, account he did not want to pay taxes, but that he was told that if he did not take the patent he would be forced to accept it, and pay the taxes, so he accepted it
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Isaac H. Chase, of Rapid City, South Dakota, for $500.00; sold in 1926 to Sam Pelley, of Chadron, Nebraska, for $1180.00, receiving $680.00 in cash, and Mr. Pelley assuming the mortgage in favor of Mr. Chase
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: could not pay his taxes; was unable to keep up the payment on this mortgage
extraction.Occupation/Income: income is made up from what he makes farming on a small scale, and what he can pick up at threshing, farm work, road work, or anything he can find to do
extraction.NOTES: Mentally competent, has good health; has a wife and four minor children, all of good health; finds it pretty close living on his income; mortgaged the place in 1920; has never received any aid from the County or the United States Government; document subscribed and sworn November 16, 1928 | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Shannon County, South Dakota (reservation not explicitly named)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')
